entries.def:
ἐπι-λανθάνομαι
(alternative mid, form of ἐπιλήθω, to cause to forget) [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַח ;] 
to forget, neglect: with inf., Mat.16.5, Mrk.8.14; with genitive, Heb.6.10; 13.2, 16; with accusative (as occasionally in cl.; MM, Exp., xiv), Php.3.13 ὁποῖος ἦν, Jas.1.24 pass. ptcp. (cf. Isa.23.16, Sir.3.14; 23.14, Wis.2.4), Luk.12.6.†
(AS)

ἐπι-λέγω 
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;] 
__1. to say in addition (Hdt.). 
__2. to call by name, to call: Jhn.5.2. 
__3. to choose; mid., to choose for oneself: Act.15.40.†
(AS)

ἐπι-λείπω 
[in LXX: Ob 5 א1 R (שָׁאַר hi.) * ;] 
to fail: with accusative of person(s), Heb.11.32.†
(AS)

ἐπι-λησμονή, -ις, ή
(επιλήθω), [in LXX: Sir.11.27 * ;] 
forgetful­ness: ἀκροατὴς ἐ. (genitive of qual.), Jas.1.25.†
(AS)

ἐπί-λοιπος, -ον
(λοιπός), [in LXX for יָתַר, שָׁאַר ;] 
still left, remaining: χρόνος, 1Pe.4.2.†
(AS)

ἐπί-λυσις -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιλύω), [in Aq.: Gen.40.8 Sm.: Hos.3.4 * ;] 
__1. release. 
__2. solution, interpretation: 2Pe.1.20.†
(AS)

ἐπι-λύω 
[in Aq.: Gen.40.8; 41.8, 12; Th.: Hos.3.4 * ;] 
__1. to loose, release. 
__2. to solve, settle, explain: Mrk.4.34, Act.19.39.†
(AS)

ἐπι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ 
to bear witness to: with accusative and inf., 1Pe.5.12,†
(AS)

ἐπιμέλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιμελέομαι), [in LXX: Pro.3.8 (שִׁקּוּי), Wis.13.13, Est.6.10, 1Ma.16.14, al. ;] 
attention, care: Act.27.3 (see Field, Notes, 143).†
(AS)

ἐπι-μελεομαι, -οῦμαι 
[in LXX: Gen.44.21 (עַיִן שׂוּם) I Est.6.27, Pro.27.25, Sir.30.25, 1Ma.11.37 * ;] 
to take care of: with genitive, Luk.10.34-35, 1Ti.3.5.†
(AS)
